dashboard.label: TA-ups Overview
dashboard.description: Collects UPS health from Network UPS Tools (upsc) or apcupsd (apcaccess) when a UPS server is reachable: device model, online/off-battery status, battery charge, load and input

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-ups" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-ups. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-ups requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-ups", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-ups/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms
| mstats avg("ups.device_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

index=main sourcetype="ups:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"on_battery\":\s*(?<b>[01])" | mvexpand b | where b="1" | stats count(b) as value

index=main sourcetype="ups:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"battery_charge\":\s*(?<b>[0-9.]+)" | stats count(b) as n avg(b) as value | eval value=if(n>0,value,0) | fields value

index=main sourcetype="ups:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"load\":\s*(?<l>[0-9.]+)" | stats count(l) as n avg(l) as value | eval value=if(n>0,value,0) | fields value

index=main sourcetype="ups:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"battery_charge\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=model | spath input=o path=input_voltage | spath input=o path=battery_voltage | spath input=o path=battery_charge | spath input=o path=load | spath input=o path=on_battery | spath input=o path=delay_shutdown | table host k model input_voltage battery_voltage battery_charge load on_battery delay_shutdown
